prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a low-speed head-on collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1183; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed head-on collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle and third-party vehicle both sustained front-end damage. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness beginning shortly after the impact. No police report filed at scene; both parties exchanged information. Vehicle inspection scheduled.

Entry 2: Claimant contacted by phone. Stated he is not represented by an attorney and does not intend to retain one at this time. Claimant reports ongoing whiplash symptoms, including restricted neck movement and headaches. Advised claimant of his right to seek medical evaluation and to keep all treatment receipts. Medical authorization form sent.

Entry 3: Repair estimate received for the claimant's vehicle. Damage consistent with a low-speed frontal impact, primarily bumper cover, radiator support, and headlamp assembly. Photos reviewed and filed. Claimant confirmed he has visited his primary care provider and is attending physical therapy twice weekly.

Entry 4: Claimant submitted medical records from initial evaluation. Diagnosis noted as cervical strain consistent with whiplash-type injury. Reviewed treatment plan with claimant, who asked general questions about how the claim process works and what documents are needed. Explained that I can provide information but cannot give legal advice, and recommended he consult an attorney if he has concerns about his rights.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Reports neck pain has partially improved but still limits driving for extended periods. Confirmed receipt of medical bills and wage loss documentation. Claim file updated and referred to supervisor for evaluation of injury component. Next contact scheduled after physical therapy progress report is received.
